name: webfluent-browser-tests
description: What only a real browser can check: `offline`'s service worker, `peer`'s WebRTC, the project's own scripts, layers in the top layer, keys, gestures, and a project's own storage. `npm test` runs all seven.

scripts.test: node offline.mjs && node peer.mjs && node scripts.mjs && node layers.mjs && node keys.mjs && node gestures.mjs && node storage.mjs
